mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals strong demand, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers labor market tightening, improving investor sentiment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or IC < 0.03 over any 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and increase in PAYEMS (payroll jobs) signals economic recovery, prompting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both proxies move as expected, or IC < 0.05 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 102.5 and UNRATE < 4.0%), robust industrial production and low unemployment drive S&P 500 positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not positive in such regimes, or IC < 0.03 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant returns when FEDFUNDS declines, or IC < 0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 23,500 signals strong demand, prompting short-term equity inflows and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No positive returns when GDPC1 crosses threshold, or IC < 0.05 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate robust economic activity, driving long-term equity appreciation and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase in the same month
failure_condition: No significant returns when both proxies rise, or IC < 0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL < 315.5), persistent inflation concerns may delay S&P 500 gains, resulting in negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with controlled inflation
failure_condition: Positive returns when expected negative signal occurs, or IC > 0.05 over 6-month period.
